paragraphs.text: Now, to the great Shepherd over all of us, the Lord Jesus Christ, and in His Name, I lay my hands upon my sister. May the God, Who made her and brought her to this earth, may His Spirit that sealed her away from the things of the world, to be Your servant, may It heal her sick body and make her completely well. For we need her in the service, Lord. I commit her to You, with this prayer of faith, my hands laying upon her, to identify myself with the prayer, and say to this mountain, “In the Name of Jesus Christ, be moved,” that our sister may live to the Kingdom of God, and for the glory of God. July 5, 1964, sitting in his office at the Branham Tabernacle in Jeffersonville, Indiana, during the song service preceding his Message, The Masterpiece. Sister Bruce, born August 8, 1902, lived twenty-seven years for Jesus Christ after this interview, and died August 7, 1991, at the age of eighty-nine.
